name: cinematic-shot-prompting
description: Compiles natural narrative camera movements into a deterministic 7-Slot Camera Motion Contract (Anchor, Mechanism, Velocity, Subject Lock, Parallax, Environmental Response, Landing) for diffusion video generators (Runway Gen-3, Kling, Sora, Luma Dream Machine).
